name.en: Stepping out of the contest area

summary.en: Leaving the contest area on purpose. The rules count it as a lack of combativity, and it draws a shido.

about.en: Stepping out of the contest area on purpose is a lack of combativity and draws a shido. Being thrown or forced out is a different matter, and the rules treat forcing an opponent out as an offence of its own.

watchFor.en: The feet at the edge of the area. Watch whether the step out comes from the judoka's own movement, with no throw or push behind it.
